First pixel lands just below a requantization half: exact 250000 * f32(0.02) * f32(0.015) / 2 rounds to 37, while rounded intermediate products can produce the tie 37.5. Remaining pixels vary to exercise indexing and saturation. Every inline output was evaluated with rational arithmetic. ONNX Runtime's CPU provider produces 166 instead of 165 at the first pixel (and 90 instead of 91 for the negative-bias channel); its f32 intermediate lands on a tie. The ORT check records this provider divergence without changing the exact GPU tolerance.
provenance.source: Exact rational requantization of integer dot products and stored float32 scales
